column1: # zxfer anti-rebloat budget policy (TAB-separated).
# Checked by tests/run_budget_check.sh (lint target: budget).
# Ratchet-down-only: lowering a MAX is routine maintenance; raising ANY value
# requires explicit justification in the PR that edits it.
# Record kinds:
#   lines <src/FILE|zxfer|TOTAL> MAX -- max wc -l line count
#   functions <src/FILE|zxfer|TOTAL> MAX -- max top-level function definitions
#   callers SYMBOL MAX [ALLOWED_FILES] -- max grep -rnF match lines for the
#     literal SYMBOL across src/ + zxfer; the optional comma-separated
#     ALLOWED_FILES list pins which files may contain matches at all.
# Refresh current values with: tests/run_budget_check.sh --list

# descendant reaper must list every process, not just same-terminal ones);

# zxfer_cli.sh, zxfer_reporting.sh, and zxfer_runtime.sh rose slightly when
# the Phase 6 adversarial review landed safety fixes: the deferred
# corrupt-metadata reap recheck in error-log lock acquisition, the held
# unsafe-TMPDIR fallback advisory replayed after option parsing, main-shell
# start-token memoization comments, and the randomized staging-name helper
# for shared sticky parents. The TOTAL row still sits ~1,200 lines below the
# pre-Phase 6 baseline.

# parse memos (OPTIMIZATION 11): rendered ssh transport argv and the parsed
# host/wrapper split are computed once per role and replayed per command.
# The growth is paid for many times over by the ~1,900-line remote_hosts

# zxfer_remote_hosts.sh halved in Phase 7: capability state is one live ssh
# probe per host per run held in memory (no cache files, TTL, identity hex,
# lock dirs, or wait loops) and ssh control sockets are per-run paths under
# the private run temp root (no socket locks, leases, identity files, or
# foreign-socket reaping).

# refine/diff helpers, so the TOTAL row still ratchets down.
